    Type I error curve using Gaussian/Binomial DGPs

    type1_error_curve_mean_dgp.Rd

    Simulates superpopulation data via simulate_crossfit_data() and evaluates empirical and analytical Type I error across an effect-size grid by repeatedly calling simulate_power_ppi_mean().

    type1_error_curve_mean_dgp(
  effect_grid,
  N,
  n,
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  superpop_n = 5000,
  p = 5,
  K = 5,
  seed = 1,
  alpha = 0.05,
  R = 2000
)

    Arguments

    effect_grid

    Numeric vector of effect sizes \(\theta - \theta_0\) to evaluate.

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    n

    Labeled sample size used inside simulate_power_ppi_mean().

    family

    GLM family passed to the DGP; defaults to stats::gaussian() (with identity link) or stats::binomial() (logistic).

    superpop_n

    Size of the synthetic superpopulation used to estimate variance components.

    p

    Number of covariates in the DGP.

    K

    Number of folds for cross-fitting.

    seed

    Random seed forwarded to simulate_crossfit_data().

    alpha

    Two-sided significance level.

    R

    Number of Monte Carlo replicates passed to simulate_power_ppi_mean().

    Value

    Data frame with columns effect_size, type1_empirical, type1_exact, theta, theta0, and additional metadata mirroring the inputs.

    Examples

    type1_error_curve_mean_dgp(
  effect_grid = seq(-0.4, 0.4, by = 0.05),
  N = 4000,
  n = 200,
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  R = 2000
)
